facts.value: We’re embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do.
facts.context:
Epic Games communications director Jake Jones told Bloomberg, "We’re embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do."

Some Epic developers were reportedly shocked by the AI-first pivot.

The same message is then said to have added that all art for the project would be "generated with full AI workflows."

The report continued, stating that Epic underestimated the time and resources necessary to develop the Star Wars and Marvel shooter.
"No more hand-written code," one of the directors on the game told staff, according to Bloomberg.

"The aim isn't to do the same stuff with fewer people, but to enable everyone here to build MORE and BETTER stuff, and to bring the benefits to all teams using Unreal."

Disney invested $1.5 billion in Epic Games in 2024, and also agreed to a multi-game partnership with Epic.
